summary: Old Bitly short links in years-old X posts (Trump, Burger King, McDonald's) were hijacked and redirected; Bitly says it suspended the accounts and is disabling the links.
A Reddit thread asks about redirect spam showing up with Sovrn affiliate links.
Lasso, URLgenius, Button/Posttap and Amazon's own tools were quiet.

items.title: Old Bitly links in Trump, Burger King and other prominent X accounts redirected to unrelated websites
items.why: Short links can be changed long after they're posted, so trust in where a link goes is a real issue for every link tool, and brands and creators will be asking who controls their old links.

items.title: Bitly: bad actors repurposed old, inactive links; accounts suspended and links being disabled
Redirect spam with Sovrn affiliate links? Anyone?
